summary: AI agent safety guardrails for tool calls. Use when (1) you want to validate agent tool calls before execution, (2) building agents that run shell commands, file operations, or API calls, (3) adding a safety layer to any MCP server or agent framework, (4) auditing what your agents are doing. Catches destructive commands, SSRF, SQL injection, path traversal, data exfiltration, prompt injection, and credential leaks. Zero dependencies, under 2ms.
